The beauty and fragility of roses have been celebrated through poetry and art for centuries in the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, roses have spiritual significance in Islam as they are mentioned in several verses in the Quran. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) also spoke fondly of roses and their beautiful colors. In Islamic traditions, roses are believed to symbolize the love and affection of God towards His creations and the lover's longing and devotion to the beloved. Therefore, the name Sawsanah can also be seen as a reminder of the spiritual connection we have with the Divine and the unending love that God has for His creation.
